title: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric (DP-700) practice questions

exams.name: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: What is OneLake in Microsoft Fabric?
options: A single, tenant-wide logical data lake that stores data for all Fabric items in Delta Parquet format
A separate storage account that each user must create
questions.correct_rationale: OneLake is the unified storage layer for Fabric, built on ADLS Gen2.
questions.distractor_summary: It is provided automatically, is not only a database engine, and is not a reporting tool.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: A data engineering team wants Spark sessions in a workspace to start faster and use a specific library set by default. What should be configured?
options: Workspace Spark settings, such as a default environment with libraries and the starter pool or a custom pool
questions.correct_rationale: Workspace Spark settings set default pools, runtimes, and environments.
questions.distractor_summary: Themes, statistics, and retention policies do not affect Spark sessions.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: What is a Fabric environment item used for?
options: Defining Spark runtime, libraries, and compute properties that notebooks and Spark job definitions can share
questions.correct_rationale: Environments package Spark settings and libraries for reuse.
questions.distractor_summary: They do not store models, host eventstreams, or define roles.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: A company wants to group workspaces by business area so that governance and discovery follow the organization's structure. What should be configured?
options: Fabric domains, with workspaces assigned to them
Separate tenants for each business area
questions.correct_rationale: Domains organize workspaces logically for data mesh style governance.
questions.distractor_summary: One workspace mixes everything, separate tenants are excessive, and pipelines manage lifecycle.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: Which Fabric capacity setting determines the compute resources available to workspaces assigned to it?
options: The capacity SKU, such as F64
questions.correct_rationale: Fabric capacities are sized by SKU, which sets available capacity units.
questions.distractor_summary: Descriptions, item counts, and branch names do not change capacity.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: Notebook jobs in a workspace must be allowed to run more concurrent Spark jobs with high concurrency. What setting helps?
options: Enable high concurrency mode for notebooks or pipelines in the workspace Spark settings
Increase the semantic model refresh rate
questions.correct_rationale: High concurrency mode lets multiple notebooks share a Spark session.
questions.distractor_summary: Refresh rates, viewers, and OneLake settings do not change Spark concurrency.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: What is the starter pool in Fabric Spark?
options: A pool of Power BI reports
A prewarmed default Spark pool that gives fast session start times
questions.correct_rationale: Starter pools are always-on clusters that start sessions in seconds.
questions.distractor_summary: They are not for warehouses, reports, or KQL caches.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: A workspace must use a managed private endpoint to reach an Azure SQL Database that blocks public access. Where is this configured?
options: In a semantic model's refresh schedule
In the Power BI theme settings
In the workspace's network security settings, creating a managed private endpoint for the data source
questions.correct_rationale: Managed private endpoints let Fabric Spark reach private data sources securely.
questions.distractor_summary: Refresh schedules, themes, and statistics do not configure network access.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: Which OneLake feature lets you reference data in ADLS Gen2, Amazon S3, or another lakehouse without copying it?
questions.correct_rationale: Shortcuts point to data in other locations so it appears in OneLake.
questions.distractor_summary: Pipelines, labels, and staging do not virtualize data.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: A workspace admin wants to prevent Spark from writing data with V-Order to speed up write-heavy ingestion. Where can this be changed?
options: In the Power BI report theme
In Spark configuration, such as session properties or an environment
questions.correct_rationale: V-Order can be enabled or disabled through Spark properties.
questions.distractor_summary: Themes, domains, and Git settings do not control write optimizations.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: A team wants Fabric item definitions stored in source control so changes can be reviewed and branched. What should they configure?
options: Workspace Git integration with Azure DevOps or GitHub
Manual exports of items to a shared folder
questions.correct_rationale: Git integration syncs supported items to a repository branch.
questions.distractor_summary: Manual exports lack history, pipelines promote content, and shortcuts reference data.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: What do Fabric deployment pipelines do?
options: Promote content between stages such as development, test, and production workspaces
questions.correct_rationale: Deployment pipelines move items through lifecycle stages.
questions.distractor_summary: They do not ingest data, store tables, or create pools.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: Connection strings differ between test and production when items are deployed through a deployment pipeline. What should be used?
options: Edit items manually after each deployment
Use the same production connection everywhere
Deployment rules (or parameters) that change data source settings per stage
questions.correct_rationale: Deployment rules swap values when content moves between stages.
questions.distractor_summary: Manual edits are error-prone, sharing production connections is risky, and disabling pipelines loses automation.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: Which project type lets a team manage warehouse schema as code, with build and deploy steps?
questions.correct_rationale: Database projects define schema objects as code for source control and deployment.
questions.distractor_summary: Themes, querysets, and schedules do not define schema as code.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: A developer works in a feature workspace connected to a feature branch. How should changes get to the main workspace?
options: Commit changes to the feature branch, open a pull request into main, and update the main workspace from Git after merge
questions.correct_rationale: Branching with pull requests gives reviewed changes.
questions.distractor_summary: Manual copying and direct edits bypass review, and deletion is destructive.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: When Git integration shows a conflict between the workspace and the branch, what must happen?
options: The conflict must be resolved, for example by choosing which version to keep or resolving in Git, before syncing
Fabric merges the changes automatically without input
questions.correct_rationale: Conflicts need explicit resolution before sync.
questions.distractor_summary: Automatic merges do not happen, and deletion is not part of the process.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: Deployment must be automated from a CI/CD tool rather than clicked in the portal. What can be used?
options: Fabric REST APIs for deployment pipelines and Git operations, called from Azure Pipelines or GitHub Actions
Manual uploads of PBIX files every time
questions.correct_rationale: Fabric APIs support automating deployments and Git updates.
questions.distractor_summary: Email and manual uploads are not automation, and shortcuts reference data.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: How many stages can a Fabric deployment pipeline have?
options: Between two and ten customizable stages
questions.correct_rationale: Deployment pipelines support from two to ten stages.
questions.distractor_summary: One stage cannot promote, three is the default but can change, and the number is limited.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: A team wants to compare item differences between test and production before deploying. What feature helps?
options: The compare view in deployment pipelines
questions.correct_rationale: Deployment pipelines show which items are different or new between stages.
questions.distractor_summary: Monitoring and metrics tools do not compare stages.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: Which workspace role can add members, delete the workspace, and manage all settings?
questions.correct_rationale: Admins have full control, including deleting the workspace.
questions.distractor_summary: Members, Contributors, and Viewers have fewer rights.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: Which workspace role can create and edit items but cannot share items or add members?
questions.correct_rationale: Contributors can create and edit content.
questions.distractor_summary: Viewers only view, and Admins and Members can manage access.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: Analysts need to query a warehouse's tables with T-SQL but must not see other items in the workspace. What should be granted?
options: Item permissions on the warehouse, such as Read and ReadData, by sharing the item
questions.correct_rationale: Item-level sharing grants access to one item without workspace roles.
questions.distractor_summary: Workspace roles give access to all items in the workspace.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: Sales staff must see only rows for their own region in a warehouse table. What should be implemented?
options: A separate warehouse per region with copied data
Row-level security with a security policy and predicate function
questions.correct_rationale: RLS filters rows based on the user running the query.
questions.distractor_summary: CLS hides columns, separate copies drift, and masking hides values but returns all rows.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: What does column-level security do in a Fabric warehouse?
options: Restricts which columns a user can select, using GRANT on specific columns
questions.correct_rationale: Column permissions control access to specific columns.
questions.distractor_summary: RLS hides rows, encryption is separate, and data types are unchanged.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: Support staff must see only the last four digits of customer phone numbers in query results. What should be used?
options: Dynamic data masking with a partial mask function
questions.correct_rationale: Dynamic data masking obscures values in query results for non-privileged users.
questions.distractor_summary: RLS filters rows, shortcuts reference data, and deployment rules change settings.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: What is the purpose of sensitivity labels from Microsoft Purview in Fabric?
options: Classifying and protecting data, with labels that can follow data when exported
questions.correct_rationale: Sensitivity labels mark and protect sensitive content.
questions.distractor_summary: They do not affect speed, schedules, or Spark pools.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: Users must access lakehouse data through OneLake, but only certain folders. What feature applies?
options: OneLake data access roles (OneLake security) defining folder- or table-level access
questions.correct_rationale: OneLake security roles grant access to specific folders or tables.
questions.distractor_summary: Viewer covers the workspace, deployment rules change settings, and labels classify data.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: What is endorsement in Fabric?
options: Marking items as Promoted or Certified so users can find trustworthy content
questions.correct_rationale: Endorsement signals quality and trust.
questions.distractor_summary: It does not encrypt, grant rights, or schedule.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: Auditors need a record of who accessed and changed Fabric items. Where can this be found?
options: The Microsoft Purview audit log, which captures Fabric activities
questions.correct_rationale: Fabric user activities are recorded in the unified audit log.
questions.distractor_summary: Spark history, query plans, and caches do not audit user activity.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: Which T-SQL statement grants a user SELECT on a single table in a Fabric warehouse?
questions.correct_rationale: GRANT gives object-level permissions.
questions.distractor_summary: CREATE, DROP, and ALTER DATABASE perform other actions.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: A lakehouse's SQL analytics endpoint should apply row-level security for report users. Where is RLS defined?
options: Using T-SQL security policies on the SQL analytics endpoint tables
questions.correct_rationale: The SQL analytics endpoint supports T-SQL security features such as RLS.
questions.distractor_summary: Notebooks, Git settings, and pipelines do not define RLS for SQL queries.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: Which item permission allows a user to read lakehouse data through Spark and OneLake APIs?
questions.correct_rationale: ReadAll grants access to the underlying OneLake data.
questions.distractor_summary: ReadData covers SQL, Build is for semantic models, and Reshare allows sharing.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: Data owners want to restrict who can see certain items in the OneLake catalog. What helps?
options: Item permissions and workspace roles, since the catalog shows items users can access, along with endorsement for trusted items
A public share link for every item
questions.correct_rationale: Visibility follows permissions, and endorsement highlights trusted items.
questions.distractor_summary: Public links expose content, removing endorsement hides quality signals, and Spark settings are unrelated.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: A daily process must copy files, run a notebook, and refresh a semantic model in order, with retry on failure. What should be used?
options: A Data Factory pipeline in Fabric with Copy, Notebook, and Semantic model refresh activities, with retry settings
questions.correct_rationale: Pipelines orchestrate ordered activities with retries and schedules.
questions.distractor_summary: Bookmarks, update policies, and shortcuts do not orchestrate steps.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: When should you choose a notebook over a Dataflow Gen2 for transformation?
options: When users want a no-code interface
When only a few rows must be renamed by business users
When the logic needs code, such as PySpark or Spark SQL, complex transformations, or large-scale processing
When a report theme must change
questions.correct_rationale: Notebooks suit code-based, large-scale transformations.
questions.distractor_summary: Dataflows suit low-code transformations, and themes are unrelated.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: A pipeline must process files as soon as they land in OneLake or Azure Blob Storage. What should be configured?
options: An event-based trigger (storage event) on the pipeline through Fabric eventing
questions.correct_rationale: Event triggers start pipelines when files are created.
questions.distractor_summary: Weekly schedules and manual runs are not immediate, and deployment rules are unrelated.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: Which pipeline activity runs a set of activities for each item in a list?
questions.correct_rationale: ForEach iterates over a collection.
questions.distractor_summary: If Condition branches, Wait pauses, and Set variable assigns values.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: A notebook must receive a date value from a pipeline. What should be used?
options: A parameter cell in the notebook and base parameters set in the Notebook activity
Hard-code the date in the notebook
questions.correct_rationale: Parameter cells let pipelines pass values to notebooks.
questions.distractor_summary: Hard-coding prevents reuse, and shortcuts and labels do not pass values.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: Which pipeline expression returns the current UTC time?
questions.correct_rationale: utcNow returns the current UTC timestamp.
questions.distractor_summary: RunId identifies the run, item is used in ForEach, and activity output reads results.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: A notebook should run another notebook and pass parameters, then continue with its result. What can be used?
options: notebookutils.notebook.run (mssparkutils) with parameters and a returned exit value
questions.correct_rationale: Notebook utilities let notebooks call other notebooks and return values.
questions.distractor_summary: Refreshes, deployment rules, and KQL functions do not run notebooks.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: What does the Invoke pipeline activity do?
options: Calls another pipeline from within a pipeline
questions.correct_rationale: Invoke pipeline enables modular orchestration.
questions.distractor_summary: It does not create workspaces, refresh tiles, or delete files.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: A pipeline should send an email when a copy activity fails. What should be done?
options: Connect an Office 365 Outlook or Teams activity to the copy activity's On failure path
questions.correct_rationale: Failure dependency paths run notification activities.
questions.distractor_summary: Wait, timeouts, and roles do not send notifications.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: Which tool can run Spark code on a schedule without a notebook interface, using a main definition file?
questions.correct_rationale: Spark job definitions run batch or streaming Spark applications from files.
questions.distractor_summary: Dataflows are low-code, querysets run KQL, and dashboards visualize.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: A pipeline must run a notebook only if new files were found by a Get Metadata activity. What should be used?
options: A Wait activity of one hour
A Lookup on a different table only
An If Condition activity that checks the Get Metadata output
questions.correct_rationale: If Condition branches based on activity output.
questions.distractor_summary: ForEach iterates, Wait pauses, and an unrelated Lookup does not check new files.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: Where can you schedule a notebook to run daily without creating a pipeline?
questions.correct_rationale: Notebooks can be scheduled directly.
questions.distractor_summary: The other locations do not schedule notebooks.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: A Dataflow Gen2 must run after a pipeline copies raw data. How should this be orchestrated?
options: Schedule both at the same time
Add a Dataflow activity after the Copy activity in the pipeline
questions.correct_rationale: Pipelines enforce order with activity dependencies.
questions.distractor_summary: Same-time schedules can conflict, manual runs are not automated, and shortcuts do not transform.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: Which pipeline feature limits how long an activity can run before failing?
questions.correct_rationale: Timeouts stop activities that run too long.
questions.distractor_summary: Descriptions, shortcuts, and labels do not limit runtime.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: Pipelines in several workspaces must use the same connection to an on-premises SQL Server. What is required?
options: An on-premises data gateway and a shared connection that pipelines can use
A public IP on the SQL Server
questions.correct_rationale: Gateways let Fabric reach on-premises data through managed connections.
questions.distractor_summary: Public IPs are risky, shortcuts do not support on-premises SQL Server, and environments configure Spark.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: What is the role of the Lookup activity in a pipeline?
options: Reading a dataset or query result, such as a list of tables, for use by later activities
questions.correct_rationale: Lookup returns data that downstream activities use.
questions.distractor_summary: It does not write data, refresh reports, or assign roles.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: A team wants to orchestrate Fabric items using Apache Airflow DAGs. What option exists in Fabric?
options: Apache Airflow jobs in Fabric Data Factory
questions.correct_rationale: Fabric supports running Airflow DAGs as a managed experience.
questions.distractor_summary: Update policies, subscriptions, and deployment rules do not run DAGs.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: Which pipeline activity copies data between sources and destinations at scale?
questions.correct_rationale: Copy data moves data between supported stores.
questions.distractor_summary: Script runs SQL, Wait pauses, and Fail ends with an error.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: A pipeline must stop and report a clear error when a validation check fails. What activity helps?
options: The Fail activity with a custom message and error code
questions.correct_rationale: Fail ends the pipeline with a defined error.
questions.distractor_summary: Wait pauses, Set variable assigns, and Copy moves data.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: What does a Dataflow Gen2 data destination setting control?
options: Which users can see the dataflow
Where transformed data is written, such as a lakehouse or warehouse table, and whether it appends or replaces
questions.correct_rationale: Data destinations define output targets and update methods.
questions.distractor_summary: Permissions, Spark, and Git are separate settings.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: A notebook needs credentials for an external API. Where should they be stored?
options: In Azure Key Vault, retrieved with notebookutils.credentials using the user or workspace identity
In a notebook cell as plain text
questions.correct_rationale: Key Vault keeps secrets out of code.
questions.distractor_summary: Plain text, files, and names expose secrets.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: What is the workspace identity in Fabric?
options: A user account that owns the workspace
A managed identity tied to a workspace that can authenticate to supported data sources
questions.correct_rationale: Workspace identities let Fabric items access resources without user credentials.
questions.distractor_summary: It is not a user, branch, or SKU.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: A pipeline runs a notebook for 200 tables one at a time and takes too long. How can it be sped up?
options: Run the ForEach activity in parallel with a suitable batch count, or process several tables in one Spark session
Use a larger Power BI theme
questions.correct_rationale: Parallelism reduces total runtime.
questions.distractor_summary: Waits slow it down, running less often does not help each run, and themes are unrelated.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: Which Fabric item lets business users build low-code transformations with Power Query?
questions.correct_rationale: Dataflow Gen2 uses Power Query Online.
questions.distractor_summary: Spark jobs are code, KQL databases store data, and eventstreams handle streams.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: Notebook runs triggered by a pipeline must use a specific Spark environment. What should be done?
options: Set it in the semantic model
Attach the environment to the notebook or set it as the workspace default
Set it in the report theme
Set it in the deployment pipeline only
questions.correct_rationale: Notebooks use the attached environment or the workspace default.
questions.distractor_summary: Models, themes, and deployment pipelines do not set Spark environments.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: What is the purpose of the Until activity?
options: Repeating a set of activities until a condition is true or a timeout is reached
Running activities in parallel for each item
questions.correct_rationale: Until loops while waiting for a condition.
questions.distractor_summary: ForEach handles items, Copy moves data, and deleting is unrelated.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: A pipeline should run every 15 minutes during business hours. What should be configured?
options: An event trigger on file deletion
A schedule trigger with a 15-minute interval and start and end times
questions.correct_rationale: Schedules define recurrence and time windows.
questions.distractor_summary: File deletion events, manual runs, and deployment rules do not fit.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: A workspace must be moved to a larger capacity to handle heavier workloads. Who can do this, and where?
options: Any viewer from the report page
A contributor from the notebook toolbar
A workspace admin with permission on the target capacity, in the workspace's License info settings
questions.correct_rationale: Workspace admins reassign workspaces to capacities they can assign to.
questions.distractor_summary: Viewers and contributors cannot change capacity, and support is not required.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: Which OneLake setting allows users to access workspace data through the OneLake file explorer and external tools?
options: The tenant and workspace settings that allow apps outside Fabric to access OneLake data
questions.correct_rationale: OneLake access from external apps is governed by tenant settings.
questions.distractor_summary: Themes, subscriptions, and branches do not control external access.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: A team wants each developer to have an isolated workspace for changes before merging. What setup fits?
options: One shared workspace where everyone edits at once
Separate developer workspaces each connected to its own feature branch, with pull requests into the main branch
Copying production data into each report manually
questions.correct_rationale: Branch-per-developer workspaces avoid conflicts and support review.
questions.distractor_summary: Shared editing causes conflicts, manual copies drift, and disabling Git loses source control.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: Which items can be tracked in Fabric Git integration?
options: Supported items such as notebooks, pipelines, lakehouses (metadata), warehouses, semantic models, and reports
Nothing; Git integration only stores comments
questions.correct_rationale: Git integration stores item definitions, not data.
questions.distractor_summary: It covers many item types, stores definitions rather than data files, and is not comment-only.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: A table in a warehouse must hide salary columns from most users while still showing other columns. What is the simplest secure approach?
options: Column-level security granting SELECT only on permitted columns
Row-level security on the salary column
Dynamic data masking with the Admin role for everyone
Moving salaries to another workspace with no permissions model
questions.correct_rationale: CLS controls column access directly.
questions.distractor_summary: RLS filters rows, masking with admin rights reveals values, and moving data without a model does not secure it.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: Which Fabric feature shows how data flows from sources through items to reports?
questions.correct_rationale: Lineage view shows upstream and downstream dependencies.
questions.distractor_summary: Metrics, Spark history, and rules have other purposes.

questions.exam: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
questions.domain: 1. Implement and manage an analytics solution
questions.question: A pipeline must copy data from many tables listed in a control table, with each table's settings. What pattern fits?
options: One Copy activity per table built manually
A metadata-driven pipeline: Lookup reads the control table, and ForEach runs a parameterized Copy for each row
